notes.title: 🪣 Items Update
notes.notes:
📷 Camera scale was bumped up to make gameplay 🔍 bigger on screen! Previous scale was too zoomed out, making it hard to 👀see what was happening. Now the 🎮 action should be much easier to follow! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/22a3d81117305844a38a70af1f91f4c9f969d306.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/8ee84ada2440cea7337a7dae4b1f782c2dfee0c7.png[/img]
All items became 🪨 physical objects. You can 💎 share them between players, drop them, or 💀 grab items from dead players.  You can also 🔍 search boxes to find new stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/d3469ea593c240ff05b11439abe57662b02ea608.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/f0c881aebacb4a32dd7b1b75ab7e1fbadff7b957.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/d2c95a7e2f00a8c8c28f3f82f56063a3d59aa78d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/8ee84ada2440cea7337a7dae4b1f782c2dfee0c7.png[/img]
🔫 Bullets became physical objects and can 🫙 run out. Different types of bullets fit only 🎯 specific guns by caliber.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/cd1529f014618f0445dc92b940f7bfd36a4b97da.gif[/img]

notes.title: 👻 Hanging? Nah, Just Ghosting Around
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/20fb235e02c6748bbdef103dd61cc7d6c6601a73.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/8ee84ada2440cea7337a7dae4b1f782c2dfee0c7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/098bd21ed060b3735853a965ec6172d54e7fb759.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/e0dff62b967ea8345c4e8c71908eef7f6423eac8.gif[/img]

Just because your character’s gone doesn’t mean you’re out of the action. 💀 Now, you can spectate your teammates and stay engaged until the very end—because dead doesn’t mean disconnected. 👀



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/aa3b8ee10b1e40b6454f7ab2feb39cae13afa628.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/efc974efdfc1d966a7a878125c845d1590a61770.gif[/img]

Now you can see who's who with names popping up above players! 👀 The closer they are, the clearer the name—but as you move farther away, it fades out until it’s gone. 🚶‍♂️ Just a heads up, though—sometimes that “player” you’re eyeing might not actually be a real person after all! 🤔👻




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/c03db1f8d8bc6f5f36ec035f4db34674e2a74644.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/a399a60de6d2d287da2d5ee1742b44247c6c6b6d.gif[/img]

Now, every time you interact with something in the game, a name for that action will pop up right above your character 🎮. Whether you're opening a door 🚪, hacking a terminal 💻, or even just turning on the lights 💡, you’ll see exactly what you're doing. Plus, you’ll get a progress bar showing how close you are to finishing the action ⏳—because in the heat of the moment, every second counts!
